Watch Faces - BetterWatch App gives you a choice of background color for any occasion. Here you can easily create, share, and find watch faces for your Apple Watch every day. The BetterWatch app will help you stay on top of the trend and choose new watch faces every day.

EXCLUSIVE FEATURES 
+ Inspirational Stories where you can share your best Watch Faces and see what others choose 
+ Watch Studio where you can create custom Watch Faces and stand-out from others
+ Favorites Pick where you can save any Watch Faces from any sources (Inspirational Stories, Categories, other apps)
In Favorites you can keep all Watch Face ideas you've created
+ Limitation Unlock. BetterWatch unlocks the default 50 Watch Faces limitation on your device. In this app you can store unlimited Watch Faces you like and have quick access to change it every day.

GALLERY
We provide a curated Watch Faces Gallery created by our inspired designers.
We created any type of Watch Faces as Portraits, Backgrounds, Live, and Watch Complications for your better choice.
We encourage everyone to share their loved Watch Faces with other users to make this world a bit happier, productive and more fun.

COMPATIBILITY
Select your Apple Watch model to hide not compatible Watch Faces for your Watch Series.
Apple Watch Series 3 and older have restrictions with Portraits Watch Faces type.
Watch Animations have technical restrictions up to 2 seconds per one flick of the wrist.
The app may need to access your Health data: steps and distance, heart rate, etc. We only display your data on your Apple Watch Faces, we don't use it in any other way and don't store your personal data.

PREMIUM FEATURES
+ Watch Faces Studio
+ Premium Watch Faces
+ Watch Complications

Note: After your submission into Inspiration Stories we review all published ideas before they will stay available for other users.

Let's dive into the app and create your First Watch Faces. Yeah, it's easy and funny ;)
